## Checklist

- [ ] `terraform fmt` has been run on all changed files
- [ ] `terraform validate` passes without errors
- [ ] `terraform plan` output has been reviewed and is as expected
- [ ] No secrets or credentials are hardcoded (use variables or vault)
- [ ] Remote state is backed up before applying destructive changes
- [ ] Variables have descriptions and sensible defaults where appropriate
- [ ] README is updated if module inputs/outputs changed
